docs.title: User Guide
docs.text: This guide covers how to interact with the Weather Station system as an operator.

docs.title: Interfaces
docs.text:
The Weather Station exposes three user interfaces:

Interface Purpose Access HTTP Dashboard Live sensor data, charts, runtime configuration Browser on port 8080 UART Shell Ad-hoc inspection, sensor control, debugging Serial console LVGL Display Analog clock + live sensor cards SDL window (native_sim)

docs.title: HTTP Dashboard
docs.text: The web dashboard is the primary interface for monitoring and configuration.

docs.title: Accessing the Dashboard
docs.text:
1. Open a browser and navigate to http://<device-ip>:8080
  2. On native_sim running locally: http://localhost:8080

docs.title: Pages
docs.text: Page URL Description Dashboard / Live Chart.js timeseries of recent sensor readings, auto-refreshes every second Configuration /config HTML form for runtime settings Login /login Authentication page (only when CONFIG_HTTP_DASHBOARD_AUTH=y)

docs.title: Configuration via API
docs.text:
The dashboard exposes a REST API for programmatic access:

Endpoint Method Description /api/data GET JSON snapshot of recent sensor readings /api/config GET / POST Read or update runtime configuration /api/login POST Authenticate and receive a session cookie /api/logout POST Invalidate current session /api/change-credentials POST Change username and password /api/locations GET List registered locations /api/token/rotate POST Rotate the API bearer token

Configurable settings include: - Sensor trigger interval - SNTP server and manual resync - MQTT broker settings (server, port, authentication, gateway ID) - Sensor metadata (display name, location, user data) - Location management (add/remove/list)

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text:
When CONFIG_HTTP_DASHBOARD_AUTH=y: - Browser users log in via /login with username/password - API clients send Authorization: Bearer <token> header - Default credentials are set via Kconfig at build time - Credentials are persisted in Zephyr settings (dash/user, dash/pass, dash/token) - First login with default credentials forces a credential change (POST /api/change-credentials); other APIs return 403 password_change_required until then. - After 5 consecutive failed logins /api/login returns 429 with Retry-After. - GET /api/config does not return the API token; use the http_dashboard token show shell command.

When CONFIG_HTTP_DASHBOARD_AUTH=n (default for development), all endpoints are open.

docs.title: UART Shell
docs.text: The serial shell provides command-line access to subsystems. Connect via the serial console of your target device.

docs.title: Available Commands
docs.text: Command Description fake_sensors list List all fake sensor instances fake_sensors temperature_set <uid_hex> <mdegC> Set a fake sensor's temperature fake_sensors humidity_set <uid_hex> <m_pct_rh> Set a fake sensor's humidity fake_sensors co2_set <uid_hex> <mppm> Set a fake sensor's CO2 value fake_sensors voc_set <uid_hex> <mIAQ> Set a fake sensor's VOC index fake_sensors trigger [uid_hex] Manually trigger a sensor sample (omit for broadcast) mqtt_pub status Show MQTT publisher status mqtt_pub set <key> <value> Update MQTT settings location add <name> Register a new location location remove <name> Remove a location location list List all registered locations remote_sensor list List paired remote sensors remote_sensor scan start\|stop [proto] Start or stop a remote sensor scan lora provision <id> Generate a pre-shared key for a node (gateway) lora forget <id> Remove a node session and its key (gateway) lora sessions List sessions without keys (gateway) lora_node provision <id> <32-hex-key> Store the node's pre-shared key (node) lora_node status Show node id, provisioning state and next seq (node) http_dashboard token show\|rotate Print or rotate the API bearer token

docs.title: LVGL Display
docs.text:
When CONFIG_LVGL_DISPLAY=y and a display backend is available (SDL on native_sim), a 320×240 window shows: - Analog clock (synced via SNTP) - Sensor data cards with live readings

The display is read-only — configuration must be done via the HTTP dashboard or shell.

docs.title: Kconfig Features
docs.text:
Features are enabled at build time via Kconfig. Key options:

Option Default Description CONFIG_HTTP_DASHBOARD y Web dashboard on port 8080 CONFIG_HTTP_DASHBOARD_AUTH y (gateway), n (Kconfig) Require login for dashboard access CONFIG_LVGL_DISPLAY y SDL display window CONFIG_MQTT_PUBLISHER y MQTT sensor data publishing CONFIG_FAKE_SENSORS y Fake sensor drivers (native_sim) CONFIG_FAKE_SENSORS_AUTO_PUBLISH_MS 1000 Auto-publish interval for fake sensors CONFIG_NET_CONFIG_CLOCK_SNTP_INIT y Boot-time SNTP sync (Zephyr net_config) CONFIG_PIPE_PUBLISHER n POSIX pipe output (integration testing)
